risks.risk: Engine may have internal wear/damage not visible in a static photo (compression, head gasket, crank/bearings).
risks.proof: Video clip of cold start + brief idle (showing no smoke/rough idle) and a compression test sheet (cylinders readings).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: needs overhaul/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Unknown engine model/compatibility (wrong engine for the buyer’s vehicle).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the engine ID plate/serial number and the full engine casting/model markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest generic engine value for a used, unidentified engine assembly.

risks.risk: Possible oil/water leaks or missing components (static photo can’t confirm completeness).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: underside for leaks, all hoses/connectors, alternator/AC compressor/power steering pump presence, and a full inventory photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown parts risk (worst case: missing or needs replacement).

risks.risk: Seller’s 'never opened' claim may be false (previous repairs, head work, or tampering).
risks.proof: Close-up of cylinder head bolts/seals, gasket condition, and any machining marks; plus photos of timing cover area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as previously opened/unknown repair history.

risks.proof: Guarantee terms in writing + proof of purchase/shipping documents (bill of lading/arrival note) and serial match.

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the engine ID plate/serial number and any model/casting codes (multiple angles).
Send a short video of the engine starting from cold and idling smoothly (no knock, no heavy smoke).
Send compression test results (all cylinders) or a mechanic’s test report with readings.
Send photos showing completeness: alternator, starter, AC compressor, power steering pump, sensors, and all major hoses/connectors.
Send written guarantee terms (what is covered, duration, and return/refund process) and any origin/shipping documents.
response.reason: From the single photo, the engine’s exact model/serial and any running/test proof are not readable or shown, so a reliable worst-case price can’t be set without the decisive identifiers and test evidence.
